physicalNotes: Radius 0.6113 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Bryant et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533.3893B/abstract): 425,281 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.635 +/- 0.016 solar masses from Bryant et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533.3893B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3943 +/- 14 K from Bryant et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2384 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533.3893B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
